**Review of the October tins email**

Going through it sentence by sentence:

- **Subject: "Your October tins are on the way"**: accurate description of a shipment, not misleading. Fine.
- **"Your subscription box left Bristol this morning."**: consistent with the Bristol packing operation. Fine.
- **"Elevate your mornings"**: "elevate" is on the brand's banned word list. It is also a generic lifestyle phrase. Needs rewording.
- **"a smoky lapsang and a soft white peony"**: product/flavour description, checked by the product team. Fine.
- **"you can pause or cancel any time from your account"**: matches the approved claim "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time". Fine.
- Sign-off and personalisation: no issues. UK spelling is fine. No health, green, urgency, guarantee or testimonial content. An email from the brand's own account needs no ad label.

**Decision:** Hold. One fix is needed: remove "Elevate your mornings". Suggested rewrite: "This month it's a smoky lapsang and a soft white peony, for slow mornings." (or simply drop the phrase).
